comment: Authorised extensions qualification — The draft already provides for federation; the correction makes the WHO option visible and prevents compliance from being judged solely by a particular server's storage model. Evidence: WHO API local deployment (https://icd.who.int/docs/icd-api/ICDAPI-LocalDeployment/).
